y-m-79-04.s.s1.explain: Ƙaruwa daga Yuni zuwa Yuli na iya zama saboda babban lokacin bazara. Domin ware ci gaba daga tasirin yanayi, ana buƙatar bayanai na “lokaci ɗaya”, kamar Yuni da Yuli na bara.

y-m-79-04.s.s2.model.0: Kwatanta da watan makamancin bara. Tallace-tallacen Yuni sun tashi daga 100万 won zuwa 120万 won, ƙaruwa 20%; Yuli kuma sun tashi daga 140万 won zuwa 156万 won, ƙaruwa kusan 11%. Na wannan shekarar ma ya fi na bara, amma ƙimar ƙaruwa ta ragu; ƙarin 30% daga Yuni zuwa Yuli ya kasance 40% a bara ma, saboda haka tasirin bazara yana da girma.

Ta wannan shekarar ƙimar ƙaruwa ta yi ƙasa. Tallace-tallace sun fi na watanni makamanta na bara, saboda haka zan gaya wa mai shi cewa shagon ya girma amma saurin ci gaba ya ragu.

y-m-79-04.s.s3.hint.0: Raba tallace-tallacen Yuni da Yuli na wannan shekarar kowanne da 1.2, sannan ka mai da su ƙimomin da za su dace da adadin kujerun bara.
y-m-79-04.s.s3.hint.1: Sanya ƙimomin da aka canza kusa da tallace-tallacen watanni makamanta na bara, sannan ka kwatanta ko sun yi daidai, sun fi girma, ko sun fi ƙanƙanta.
y-m-79-04.s.s3.o.a: A Yuni, tallace-tallace ga kowace kujera iri ɗaya ne da bara, amma a Yuli sun ragu da kusan 7%.
y-m-79-04.s.s3.r.a: Ka duba ƙimar ƙaruwa ta kujeru tare da ƙimar ƙaruwa ta tallace-tallace. Yuni: 120 ÷ 1.2 = 100, daidai da bara; Yuli: 156 ÷ 1.2 = 130, ƙasa da 140 na bara.
y-m-79-04.s.s3.o.b: Tallace-tallace ga kowace kujera sun ƙaru a Yuni da Yuli idan aka kwatanta da bara.
y-m-79-04.s.s3.r.b: Tallace-tallacen Yuni sun ƙaru 20%, kujeru kuma sun ƙaru 20%. Idan aka daidaita ƙimar ƙaruwa biyun, yana da wuya a ce tallace-tallace ga kowace kujera sun ƙaru.
y-m-79-04.s.s3.o.c: Adadin kujeru ba ya shafar tallace-tallace, saboda haka fassarar farko tana nan yadda take.
y-m-79-04.s.s3.r.c: Idan kujeru sun ƙaru, yawan abokan cinikin da za a iya yi wa hidima lokaci guda ma yana ƙaruwa. Yana da wuya a ce adadin kujeru ba shi da alaƙa da tallace-tallace.
y-m-79-04.s.s3.o.d: A Yuli, tallace-tallace ga kowace kujera sun ƙaru kusan 11%, saboda haka sun fi na Yuni girma.
y-m-79-04.s.s3.r.d: Ka ɗauki ƙimar ƙaruwa ta tallace-tallace 11% a matsayin ƙimar ƙaruwa ta tallace-tallace ga kowace kujera. Raba da ƙarin kujeru 20%.
y-m-79-04.s.s3.explain: Adadin kujeru ya zama sau 1.2, saboda haka idan aka raba tallace-tallacen wannan shekarar da 1.2 domin daidaita adadin kujeru da na bara, Yuni: 120 ÷ 1.2 = 100 (daidai da 100 na bara), Yuli: 156 ÷ 1.2 = 130 (kusan 7.1% ƙasa da 140 na bara). Ko da tallace-tallace sun ƙaru, tallace-tallace ga kowace kujera sun tsaya ko sun ragu. Idan faɗaɗa kujeru ne ya jawo ƙarin tallace-tallace, ma’anar “ci gaba” tana canzawa.

y-m-79-03.title: Samfurin da injin bincike mai ingancin '95%' ya kira mai lahani
y-m-79-03.topic: Yiwuwa mai sharadi da ingancin gwaji (ƙimar asali)
y-m-79-03.goal: Tabbatar da lambobi cewa idan sakamakon gwaji ya ce 'mai lahani', rabon ainihin masu lahani yana bambanta sosai bisa ƙimar lahani (ƙimar asali) da ƙimar kuskure, sannan ka nemo da kanka yanayi da dama da suka cika sharuɗɗan.
y-m-79-03.material:
Ga abin da aka sani game da injin binciken atomatik na wata masana'anta.
- Kayayyaki masu lahani su ne 1% na duk kayayyaki.
- Cikin kayayyaki masu lahani, an tantance 95% a matsayin masu lahani.
- Cikin kayayyaki na al'ada, an yi kuskuren tantance 5% a matsayin masu lahani.

Tallan injin ya ce 'Inganci 95%'. Wani ɗalibi ya ce, "Yiwuwa cewa samfurin da injin ya kira mai lahani yana da lahani da gaske ita ce 95%," sannan ya yi lissafi kamar haka ta amfani da kayayyaki 10000.
y-m-79-03.thinking.0: Nemo layin farko da ba daidai ba a lissafin (duba abin da aka raba da shi)
y-m-79-03.thinking.2: Faɗi bayanin da ya ɓace a furucin tallan
y-m-79-03.prereq.0: An tsara wannan aiki a matsayin wahalar H3 (mai wuya), bisa zaton ɗalibai suna ɗaukar zaɓin 'Practical Statistics' na makarantar sakandare; ba yana nufin Ma'aikatar Ilimi ta ɗora wannan abun ciki ga wani aji na musamman ba. Abubuwan da ake buƙata: lissafa kashi-kashi da rabo, da hanyar ɗaukar jimilla a matsayin 10000 sannan a ƙirga 'nawa ne'. (Ba a buƙatar amfani da dabarun yiwuwar lissafi.) Idan ka riga ka koyi yiwuwar sharadi, za ka iya tabbatar da ƙima iri ɗaya da dabara.
y-m-79-03.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi layin farko a lissafin ɗalibin da ba daidai ba ne.
y-m-79-03.s.s1.hint.0: Sake ninka lambobin a kowane layi da kanka, sannan ka duba ko daidai ne.
y-m-79-03.s.s1.hint.1: A rabon layi na ƙarshe, kwatanta 'rabo na me daga cikin me', da ko lambar da ake rabawa iri ɗaya ce da rukunin 'kayayyakin da aka kira masu lahani' a tambayar.
y-m-79-03.s.s1.line.0: Idan aka duba kayayyaki 10000, akwai 100 marasa kyau da 9900 masu kyau.
y-m-79-03.s.s1.line.1: Cikin 100 marasa kyau, ana tantance 95% (kayayyaki 95) a matsayin marasa kyau.
y-m-79-03.s.s1.line.2: Cikin 9900 masu kyau, 5% (kayayyaki 495) ma ana tantance su a matsayin marasa kyau.
y-m-79-03.s.s1.line.3: Saboda haka kayayyakin da aka tantance marasa kyau su ne 95 + 495 = 590.
y-m-79-03.s.s1.line.4: Daga cikinsu, waɗanda suke marasa kyau da gaske 95 ne, saboda haka kaso na kayayyakin da aka tantance marasa kyau waɗanda suke marasa kyau da gaske shi ne 95 ÷ 100 = 95%.
y-m-79-03.s.s1.explain: Layi na 1 zuwa na 4 daidai ne. A layi na 5, 95 daidai ne, amma abin da ya kamata a raba da shi 590 ne, “duk kayayyakin da aka tantance marasa kyau”. 100 adadin kayayyakin da suke marasa kyau a zahiri ne, bai dace da tambayar ba. 95 ÷ 590 ≈ 0.161, wato kusan 16.1%.
y-m-79-03.s.s2.prompt: Ka yi la’akari da injin dubawa mai ƙimar lahani p%, inda kaso na masu kyau da aka yi wa hukuncin kuskuren marasa kyau yake q%. (Kaso na kayayyakin marasa kyau da aka tantance marasa kyau yana nan 95%.) A ɗauka kayayyaki suna da yawa, ka ƙirƙiri nau’i-nau’i daban-daban guda 3 na (p, q) inda aƙalla rabin (50%) kayayyakin da aka tantance marasa kyau suke marasa kyau a zahiri. p da q cikakkun lambobi ne daga 1 zuwa 10.
y-m-79-03.s.s2.hint.0: Zaɓi p da q guda ɗaya, sannan cikin kayayyaki 10000 nemo adadin “waɗanda aka tantance marasa kyau kuma suke marasa kyau a zahiri” da adadin “masu kyau amma aka tantance marasa kyau”.
y-m-79-03.s.s2.hint.1: Kwatanta adadin biyun, yanke shawarar wanne dole ya fi girma domin ya kai aƙalla rabin, sannan ka canza p ko q ɗaya bayan ɗaya.
y-m-79-03.s.s2.ok.c1: p da q suna tsakanin 1 zuwa 10.
y-m-79-03.s.s2.fail.c1: Dole p da q su kasance tsakanin 1 da 10.
y-m-79-03.s.s2.fail.c2: Da fatan shigar da p da q a matsayin cikakkun lambobi.
y-m-79-03.s.s2.ok.c3: Cikin hukunce-hukuncen cewa kayayyaki marasa kyau ne, aƙalla 50% ne marasa kyau a zahiri.
y-m-79-03.s.s2.fail.c3: Cikin kayayyakin da aka tantance marasa kyau, waɗanda suke marasa kyau a zahiri sun yi ƙasa da rabi. Ɗauki kayayyaki 10000, ka kwatanta adadin hukunce-hukuncen marasa kyau da suka dace da adadin masu kyau da aka yi wa kuskuren hukunci.
y-m-79-03.s.s2.explain: Cikin kayayyaki 10000, hukunce-hukuncen marasa kyau da suka dace su ne 95 × p, masu kyau da aka yi musu kuskure kuma su ne q × (100 − p). Idan na farko ya kai aƙalla na biyun, aƙalla rabin hukunce-hukuncen marasa kyau sun dace. (2, 1) yana ba da 190 da 98; (5, 5) yana ba da 475 da 475 (daidai rabi); (10, 3) yana ba da 950 da 270. (1, 1) yana ba da 95 da 99, saboda haka bai kai rabin ba.
y-m-79-03.s.s3.prompt: Ga mai saye da ya ga tallan “Daidaito 95%” kawai kuma ya yi imanin cewa “idan ya ce mara kyau ne, 95% da gaske marasa kyau ne”, ka bayyana abin da ba za a iya sani daga wannan lamba kaɗai ba, sannan ka rubuta irin ƙarin bayanin da ya kamata ya nema.
y-m-79-03.s.s3.hint.0: Rubuta abubuwa biyun da suka haɗu suka samar da 590 a lissafin sama.
y-m-79-03.s.s3.hint.1: Nemo lambobi biyun da dole ne su canza domin girman waɗannan ɓangarori biyu ya canza.

y-m-79-03.s.s3.model.0: Kayayyakin da ba su da kyau kashi 1% ne kawai na jimillar, saboda haka masu kyau sun fi yawa sosai. Ko da 5% na masu kyau ne kawai aka yi wa kuskure, adadin 495 ne, fiye da 95 da suke marasa kyau da gaske. Don haka ko da aka ce mara kyau ne, waɗanda suke marasa kyau a zahiri kusan 16% ne. Dole a tambayi ƙimar lahani da kuma ƙimar da ake tantance masu kyau a matsayin marasa kyau bisa kuskure.
y-m-79-03.s.s3.model.1: Kana buƙatar sanin ko 95% kason lahani da aka gano ne ko kason hukuncin da ya dace, sannan kana kuma buƙatar sanin kaso kayayyakin marasa kyau nawa ne daga jimillar. Idan ƙimar da ake yi wa masu kyau hukuncin kuskuren marasa kyau ta yi yawa, masu kyau na iya fi yawa cikin waɗanda aka kama.

y-m-79-01.title: Abin da Takaitaccen Ƙimomi Biyar Zai Iya Faɗa Maka
y-m-79-01.goal: Daga takaitaccen ƙimomi biyar (mafi ƙaranci, quartiles, median, mafi girma), rarrabe abin da za a iya faɗa da tabbaci da abin da ba za a iya ba, sannan ka ƙirƙiri jerin bayanai daban-daban masu takaitaccen bayani iri ɗaya domin nuna iyakar wannan takaitaccen bayanin.
y-m-79-01.material:
Malami ya bayar da sakamakon tantance aiki (maki 0 zuwa 50, duk maki integers ne) da ɗalibai 7 na aji guda suka yi a matsayin 'takaitaccen ƙimomi biyar'.

Mafi ƙaranci maki 10, quartile na farko maki 15, median maki 20, quartile na uku maki 30, mafi girma maki 50.

Ka'ida: idan aka jera maki ɗalibai 7 daga mafi ƙanƙanta zuwa mafi girma a matsayin x1, x2, ..., x7 (x-daya zuwa x-bakwai), mafi ƙaranci x1 ne, quartile na farko x2 ne, median x4 ne, quartile na uku x6 ne, kuma mafi girma x7 ne. Ɗalibai da yawa na iya samun maki iri ɗaya.
y-m-79-01.thinking.1: Ƙirƙirar jerin bayanai daban-daban masu takaitaccen bayani iri ɗaya (misalan ƙaryatawa)
y-m-79-01.thinking.2: Bayyana iyakar kwatanta ta amfani da zane-zanen akwatin
y-m-79-01.prereq.0: An tsara wannan aiki a matsayin wahalar H3 (mai wuya), bisa zaton ɗalibai suna ɗaukar zaɓin 'Practical Statistics' na makarantar sakandare; ba yana nufin Ma'aikatar Ilimi ta ɗora wannan abun ciki ga wani aji na musamman ba. Abubuwan da ake buƙata: yadda ake jera bayanai daga ƙanana zuwa babba da nemo median da quartiles, da ma'anar matsakaici. A wannan aikin, an amince cewa quartiles na bayanai 7 su ne 'ƙimomi na 2, 4, da 6 daga ƙarami' (hanyar ƙayyade quartiles na iya ɗan bambanta daga littafi zuwa littafi).
y-m-79-01.s.s1.prompt: Da sanin wannan takaitaccen bayani kaɗai, zaɓi duk abin da za a iya cewa tabbatacce ne.
y-m-79-01.s.s1.hint.0: Zana akwatuna 7 na x1 zuwa x7, sannan da farko ka rubuta maki da takaitaccen bayani ya bayar a akwatunan.
y-m-79-01.s.s1.hint.1: Nemo akwatin da ɗalibi a kowane zaɓi yake nufi, sannan ka duba ko maki a akwatin an ƙayyade ko babu komai.

y-m-79-01.s.s1.r.a: Ba a haɗa matsakaici a cikin takaitaccen bayanin ba. Median da matsakaici ƙimomi ne dabam-dabam, kuma karanta ƙimar tsakiya a matsayin matsakaici zai ɗauka cewa duk maki a ajin kusan 20 ne.
y-m-79-01.s.s1.o.b: Ɗalibin da yake na 4 daga mafi ƙanƙanta yana da maki 20.
y-m-79-01.s.s1.r.b: A wannan ƙa'idar median ita ce ƙima ta 4. Ka karanta ainihin matsayar da takaitaccen bayani ya nuna.
y-m-79-01.s.s1.o.c: Ɗalibai 2 daidai ne suka samu maki 30 ko fiye.
y-m-79-01.s.s1.r.c: Ko da x6 yana da maki 30, hakan bai tabbatar da cewa x5 bai kai 30 ba. Ɗalibi na 5 ma zai iya samun 30, saboda haka ba za ka ce 'daidai' ba.
y-m-79-01.s.s1.o.d: Aƙalla ɗalibai 4 suna da maki 20 ko fiye.
y-m-79-01.s.s1.r.d: Idan x4 maki 20 ne, x5, x6, da x7 ba za su iya zama ƙasa da x4 ba. Ka yi amfani da jerin domin samun 'aƙalla'.
y-m-79-01.s.s1.o.e: Ɗalibi ɗaya kaɗai ya samu maki 20.
y-m-79-01.s.s1.r.e: x3 ko x5 ma na iya zama 20. Idan ka yi tunanin cewa ƙima a takaitaccen bayani tana bayyana sau ɗaya kawai, za ka rasa yiwuwar akwai ɗalibai da yawa masu maki iri ɗaya.
y-m-79-01.s.s1.explain: Akwai ɗalibai 7, saboda haka na 4 daga mafi ƙanƙanta shi ne median, maki 20, kuma ɗalibai na 4 zuwa na 7 duk suna da maki 20 ko fiye, don haka 'aƙalla 4' tabbatacce ne. A gefe guda, game da x3 mun san kawai cewa yana da 15 ko fiye kuma 20 ko ƙasa da haka, x5 kuma 20 ko fiye da 30 ko ƙasa da haka; ba mu san ainihin ƙimomin ba. Saboda haka matsakaici, 'ainihin adadin masu maki 30 ko fiye', da 'ainihin adadin masu maki 20' ba za a iya tantance su daga wannan takaitaccen bayani kaɗai ba.

y-m-79-06.thinking.1: Ƙirƙiri ƙira da dama ƙarƙashin ƙa’idoji
y-m-79-06.title: Saita farashin tikitin caca na bikin makaranta
y-m-79-06.goal: Ta amfani da ƙimar da ake tsammani, ƙirƙiri hanyoyi da dama na kuɗin shiga da kyaututtuka, sannan ka bayyana bambancin sakamako guda da matsakaicin dogon lokaci.
y-m-79-06.material:
A bikin makaranta, ajinmu yana gudanar da caca mai kyauta. Akwai takardun caca 100 a akwati, mai shiga yana biyan kuɗin shiga f円 sannan ya zaro takarda ɗaya (lissafin da ke ƙasa yana amfani da matsakaici a kowace takarda).
- Takarda 1 ta kyauta ta farko: katin kyauta P円
- Takardun kyauta ta biyu 9: katin kyauta 2000円
- Sauran takardu 90: babu kyauta

Ajinmu yana biyan katunan kyauta da cikakken farashinsu. A ɗauka babu sauran kuɗaɗe. Wani ɗalibi ya ce, “Na biya 1000円, na samu kyauta ta farko, na karɓi katin kyauta, saboda haka wannan caca tana da amfani ga masu shiga.”
y-m-79-06.thinking.0: Gano kuskuren yanke hukunci bisa sakamako guda
y-m-79-06.prereq.0: An sanya aikin nan a wahalar H3 (babba), bisa zato cewa ɗalibai suna ɗaukar zaɓin “Practical Statistics” na sakandare babba; ba yana nufin Ma’aikatar Ilimi ta ware wannan abun ciki ga wani aji ba. Abubuwan da ake buƙata: ma’ana da lissafin ƙimar da ake tsammani (jimillar kyauta × yiwuwar). A wannan aiki ana fassara ƙimar da ake tsammani a matsayin “matsakaicin kuɗin da ake biya ga kowace takarda”. Ana amfani da ƙa’idar manyan lambobi ne a fahimta ta gabaɗaya kawai.
y-m-79-06.s.s1.prompt: Wace hanya ce ta fi dacewa wajen tantance da’awar ɗalibin sama?
y-m-79-06.s.s1.hint.0: Da farko nemo jimillar adadin katunan kyauta a duk takardu 100.
y-m-79-06.s.s1.hint.1: Kwatanta “matsakaicin kowace takarda”, wato jimillar da aka raba da 100, da kuɗin shiga.
y-m-79-06.s.s1.o.a: Ba za a iya sani daga sakamako guda ba. Muna buƙatar duba matsakaicin adadin da ake karɓa a duk takardun.
y-m-79-06.s.s1.r.a: Wannan tunani ne na yanke hukunci bisa matsakaicin ƙoƙari da yawa, ba sakamako guda ba.
y-m-79-06.s.s1.o.b: Akwai takardar kyauta ta farko guda 1 kawai, saboda haka yiwuwarta 1% ce kuma wannan caca tabbas ba ta da amfani ga masu shiga.
y-m-79-06.s.s1.r.b: Ka duba yiwuwar kyauta ta farko kawai. Dole a samo matsakaicin tare da kyaututtukan takardu 9 na matsayi na biyu.
y-m-79-06.s.s1.o.c: Sakamakon gwaji guda ɗaya shi ne hujja mafi tabbas, saboda haka da’awar daidai ce.
y-m-79-06.s.s1.r.c: Sakamako guda na mutum na iya zama na sa’a. Sai an buga wasa iri ɗaya sau da yawa ne sakamakon zai kusanci matsakaici.
y-m-79-06.s.s1.o.d: Ƙimar da ake tsammani kullum daidai take da kuɗin da ake samu a ƙoƙari guda, saboda haka idan an ƙididdige ta, daidai take ga ƙoƙari ɗaya ma.
y-m-79-06.s.s1.r.d: Ƙimar da ake tsammani ra’ayi ne na matsakaicin ƙoƙari da yawa. Ba ƙima ba ce da dole ta yi daidai da sakamako guda.
y-m-79-06.s.s1.explain: Sakamako guda sa’a tana shafar sa sosai. Za a iya sanin ko wasan yana da amfani ne kawai idan aka kwatanta kuɗin shiga da matsakaicin adadin da ake karɓa daga takardu 100 (ƙimar da ake tsammani).
y-m-79-06.s.s2.prompt: Yanke adadin kyautar farko P (円) da kuɗin shiga f (円) domin ajin ya cika sharuɗɗan biyu. Ƙirƙiri tsare-tsare daban-daban guda 3. (Sharadi 1) Matsakaicin kuɗin da ake biya ga kowace takarda bai fi f ba, saboda haka ajinmu ba zai yi asara a matsakaici ba. (Sharadi 2) Asarar da mai shiga yake yi a matsakaici ga kowace takarda (f − matsakaicin kuɗin da ake biya) ba ta wuce 300円. P ana ƙididdige shi a raka’ar 1000円 daga 5000円 zuwa 30000円, f kuma a raka’ar 100円 daga 100円 zuwa 1000円.
y-m-79-06.s.s2.hint.0: Da farko zaɓi P guda ɗaya, nemo jimillar katin kyauta na farko da katunan kyauta 9 na biyu, sannan ka raba da 100.
y-m-79-06.s.s2.hint.1: Ta amfani da wannan matsakaicin kuɗin da ake biya a matsayin tushe, nemo ƙarshen ƙasa da na sama na kewayon f, sannan ka zaɓi ƙima a raka’ar 100円.

y-m-79-06.s.s2.fail.c1: P dole ne ya kasance a raka’ar 1000円 daga 5000円 zuwa 30000円.

y-m-79-06.s.s2.fail.c2: f dole ne ya kasance a raka’ar 100円 daga 100円 zuwa 1000円.

y-m-79-06.s.s2.fail.c3: Matsakaicin kuɗin da ake biya ga kowace takarda ya fi kuɗin shiga, saboda haka ajin yana yin asara a matsakaici. Kwatanta f da jimillar katunan kyauta na farko da na biyu da aka raba da 100.
y-m-79-06.s.s2.ok.c4: Asarar mai shiga a matsakaici ba ta wuce 300円.
y-m-79-06.s.s2.fail.c4: Kuɗin da mai shiga ke yi asara a matsakaici ya haura 300円.
y-m-79-06.s.s2.explain: Matsakaicin kuɗin da ake biya ga kowace takarda shi ne (P + 9 × 2000) ÷ 100 = P ÷ 100 + 180円. Misali, idan P = 10000, matsakaicin 280円 ne, saboda haka f zai kasance daga 280円 zuwa 580円; a raka’ar 100円, 300, 400, da 500円 za su yiwu. Idan P = 20000, matsakaicin 380円 ne, saboda haka f zai kasance daga 400円 zuwa 680円.

y-m-79-02.title: Wanne daga cikin hanyoyin atisaye biyu ya fi tasiri?
y-m-79-02.topic: Kwatanta bisa rukunoni da saɓanin Simpson
y-m-79-02.goal: Tabbatar da bayanai cewa rabon jimilla da rabon rukuni na iya nuna kwatance akasin juna, sannan yanke hukunci kan kwatancin da ya fi dogaro da ƙarin bayanin da ake buƙata.
y-m-79-02.material: Mambobin ƙungiyar gudu 700 sun yi atisaye da ɗaya daga cikin hanyoyi biyu na tsawon wata ɗaya, kuma wani bincike ya tambaye ko sun cim ma lokacin burinsu na kansu. Mambobin sun zaɓi hanyar atisaye da kansu, kuma sun zaɓi hanyar atisayensu, ko dai 'hanya mai sauƙi' ko 'hanya mai wuya'. Mutane 350 sun zaɓi hanya A, 350 kuma hanya B. y-m-79-02.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Lissafin dole ya yi kuskure. Idan A ya fi a hanyoyin duka, B ba zai iya zama mafi girma a jimilla ba.

y-m-79-05.title: Shin duk makarantun da suka fi a matsayi ƙanana ne?

Makarantu 3 da labarin ya gabatar (makaranta, adadin masu jarabawa, matsakaici): Makaranta 가: ɗalibai 9, maki 91.2; Makaranta 나: ɗalibai 15, maki 89.0; Makaranta 다: ɗalibai 12, maki 87.5.

y-m-79-05.prereq.0: An sanya aikin nan a wahalar H3 (babba), bisa zato cewa ɗalibai suna ɗaukar zaɓin “Practical Statistics” na sakandare babba; ba yana nufin Ma’aikatar Ilimi ta ware wannan abun ciki ga wani aji ba. y-m-79-05.s.s1.hint.1: Rubuta a layi guda irin bayanan sauran makarantu da za ka buƙata domin bincika wannan da’awa.

y-m-79-05.s.s1.r.a: Wannan bayanai ne da ke duba babban gefen kawai. Idan aka kammala cewa “akwai fa’ida” ba tare da duba ko ƙananan makarantu suna gefen ƙasa ma ba, za ka yarda da sakamakon kamar yadda aka zaɓe shi aka nuna.
y-m-79-05.s.s1.o.b: Za mu iya cewa ƙananan makarantu suna da illa. Dalili kuwa shi ne matsakaici ba ya daidaita idan ɗalibai kaɗan ne.
y-m-79-05.s.s1.r.b: Tunanin cewa matsakaici ba ya daidaita yana da muhimmanci, amma ba za a iya sanin alkiblar “illa” daga wannan bayanin kaɗai ba.
y-m-79-05.s.s1.o.c: Har yanzu yana da wuya a yanke hukunci. Ba mu san yadda matsakaicin duk ƙananan makarantu ya bazu ba.
y-m-79-05.s.s1.r.c: Wannan hukunci ne da ke bincika ko bayanan makarantu 3 na sama kawai suna goyon bayan da’awar.
y-m-79-05.s.s1.o.d: An riga an tabbatar. Dalili kuwa shi ne matsakaicin maki lambobi ne na haƙiƙa.
y-m-79-05.s.s1.r.d: Ko da lambobin haƙiƙa ne, da’awar na iya canzawa bisa waɗanne makarantu aka zaɓa aka nuna.
y-m-79-05.s.s1.explain: Labarin ya gabatar da gefen makarantu masu matsakaici mafi girma kawai. Ko ƙananan makarantu gabaɗaya suna da matsakaici mai girma, ko kuma matsakaicinsu ya bazu zuwa sama da ƙasa, za a iya sani ne kawai idan an duba bayanan makarantu masu ƙasa da na manya.

y-m-79-05.s.s2.o.b: A zahiri ƙananan makarantu suna da illa. Dalili kuwa shi ne makarantu 2 na ƙarshe dukkansu ƙanana ne.
y-m-79-05.s.s2.r.b: A wannan karon ka duba ƙaramin gefen kawai ka yanke akasin hukunci. Dole ne ka kuma lura cewa makarantu 3 na farko ƙanana ne.
y-m-79-05.s.s2.o.c: Bayanan sun saɓa da juna, saboda haka ba za a iya yanke hukunci ba ta kowace hanya kuma ya fi kyau a watsar da su.
y-m-79-05.s.s2.r.c: Ba saɓani ba ne, sai dai tsari guda. Bayanin cewa matsakaicin ƙananan makarantu suna a gefuna biyu, manyan makarantu kuma sun taru wuri guda, yana da ma’ana.
y-m-79-05.s.s2.o.d: Yayin da adadin ɗalibai a makaranta ke raguwa, matsakaicinta yana saurin karkata sama ko ƙasa. Wannan ne ya sa suke taruwa a gefuna biyu.
y-m-79-05.s.s2.r.d: Ka fassara ta hanyar kallon iyakar biyu tare. Wannan ya dace da bayanin cewa idan ɗalibai suka yi ƙasa, matsakaici na iya motsawa sosai bisa sa’a.

Wannan yana nufin ƙarancin ɗalibai, yawan motsin matsakaici.
